notes.scope: Wearable defensive gear only: body armor and cloaks, warm clothing, boots, and the Infernal Helmet. Riot Shield is excluded because it is held gear already covered by Weapons and Crafting.
notes.valuePolicy: Exact mitigation, corruption rate, explosion threshold, cooldown, rarity, and drop chance are omitted because the checked sources do not support a stable complete comparison.
notes.trimPolicy: Yes is used only for the six body items positively shown in the Armour Trim Kit gallery. Warm clothing, boots, and helmets are No. Vampire Cloak and Corrupted Armour remain null.
notes.imagePolicy: Use exact isolated item renders where available. Corrupted Armour requires an identity-safe crop or remains text-first.

item.name: Leather Body
item.accessNotes: Find it in chests or begin a run with it through the Brawler class.
item.cardSummary: A basic body armor option from chests or the Brawler class that can be upgraded with an Armor Trim Kit.

item.name: Poison Armor
item.specialEffect: Poisons enemies that attack the wearer.
item.accessNotes: Use the Frog Cave or Frog Pond route, or begin with it through the Poison Master class.
item.cardSummary: Frog-route body armor that reduces damage and retaliates by poisoning attackers.

item.name: Iron Body
item.accessNotes: Search higher-tier chests or complete the Pelt Trader's fourth trade.
item.cardSummary: Straightforward damage-reduction armor from high-tier chests or the late Pelt Trader route.

item.name: Thorn Body
item.specialEffect: Damages enemies that make contact with the wearer.
item.accessNotes: Open Ruby Chests or obtain it through the assembled Tool Workshop.
item.cardSummary: Ruby Chest or Workshop armor that combines protection with contact retaliation.

item.name: Alien Armor
item.specialEffect: Restores Alien Tech Energy when the wearer is hit by a melee attack.
item.accessNotes: Follow an Alien UFO route or begin with it through the Cyborg class.
item.cardSummary: Alien-route armor that turns incoming melee hits into Alien Tech Energy while reducing damage.

item.name: Obsidiron Body
item.specialEffect: Taking damage fills an explosion meter; a full meter creates an explosion around the wearer.
item.accessNotes: Obtain it from an Obsidiron Chest.
item.equipNotes: The meter also works with Obsidiron Boots and the Obsidiron Hammer.
item.cardSummary: Obsidiron Chest armor that builds toward a nearby explosion as you take damage.

item.name: Vampire Cloak
item.specialEffect: Fills a meter at night and heals the wearer when the meter is full.
item.accessNotes: Complete the Vampire Chest route or begin with it through the Vampire class.
item.cardSummary: Night-focused protection from the Vampire route that converts a full nighttime meter into healing.

item.name: Corrupted Armour
item.effect: Provides wearable protection in Hard Mode.
item.specialEffect: Adds a corruption-management tradeoff while improving survivability.
item.accessNotes: Activate Hard Mode, then search the Corrupted Chests that appear through its corruption route.
item.cardSummary: Hard Mode chest armor that improves survivability while adding corruption-management pressure.

item.name: Earmuffs
item.accessNotes: Buy it from the Warm Clothing Shop.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn alongside body armor.
item.cardSummary: The entry-level Warm Clothing Shop option, adding +1 warmth while layering with body armor.

item.name: Beanie
item.accessNotes: Buy it from the Warm Clothing Shop.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn alongside body armor.
item.cardSummary: A +2 warmth shop option that slows freezing and layers with body armor.

item.name: Arctic Fox Hat
item.accessNotes: Buy it from the Warm Clothing Shop.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn alongside body armor.
item.cardSummary: A +4 warmth hat from the Warm Clothing Shop for stronger cold protection without replacing body armor.

item.name: Polar Bear Hat
item.accessNotes: Buy it from the Warm Clothing Shop.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn alongside body armor.
item.cardSummary: A +6 warmth shop hat for strong cold protection without replacing body armor.

item.name: Mammoth Helmet
item.accessNotes: Obtain it through the Tool Workshop.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn alongside body armor.
item.cardSummary: Workshop warm clothing that slows freezing and can be layered with body armor.

item.name: Frog Boots
item.accessNotes: Use the Frog Chest or Frog Pond route, or obtain it through Trick-or-Treating.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn alongside body armor and warm clothing.
item.cardSummary: Frog-route boots that improve jumping while leaving body armor and warm-clothing slots available.

item.name: Obsidiron Boots
item.specialEffect: Taking damage fills an explosion meter; a full meter creates an explosion around the wearer.
item.accessNotes: Craft it at the Meteor Anvil.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn with body armor and warm clothing; the meter also works with Obsidiron Body and the Obsidiron Hammer.
item.cardSummary: Meteor Anvil boots that improve sprinting and contribute to the Obsidiron explosion-meter setup.

item.name: Infernal Helmet
item.accessNotes: Obtain it through the Tool Workshop.
item.equipNotes: Can be worn with body armor and boots.
item.cardSummary: A Workshop helmet that combines damage reduction with immunity to burning.
